piece.headline: ALESTON EXTENDS LEAD AS HAALAND HANDS OUT HAULS
piece.standfirst: Aleston stays top without fuss, Akash smashes 83 and 103 managers all trusted the same striker with the armband.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut left 26 points on the bench and still climbed to 8th. Imagine the week he could have had. At the top, Aleston is now 5 clear of Arshad. The title race is quietly getting a shape.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sukrut played the Free Hit and left 26 points on the bench. Right squad, wrong 11. He still rose 10 places to 8th, which shows how well the rest of his week went.
piece.one_to_watch: Aleston leads Arshad by 5. Both have burned chips, so the fight could turn on who picks better from here. If either misjudges the armband again, the gap could swing fast.

winners.name: Akash
winners.verdict: Backed Isak when the crowd chose Haaland. The armband returned 26 and he leapt 58 places. Nerve, and it paid.

winners.name: Adit
winners.verdict: Climbed 28 places to 52nd with barely a headline. Steady hands, quiet week, big result. Skill over noise.

winners.name: Zishan
winners.verdict: Triple Captain on Haaland brought 27 from the armband, even after a 4-point hit. Obvious call, perfect timing. Smart, not brave.

losers.name: Chander
losers.verdict: Took a 13-point hit on transfers and fell 32 places. The week's lowest score. Bold shopping, awful receipt.

losers.name: Sourabh
losers.verdict: Fernandes with the armband gave 4. Another 15 points sat on the bench. Bad calls, not bad luck.

losers.name: Janit
losers.verdict: Janit left 10 points on the bench in a 33-point week. Next week's XI deserves a second look before the deadline.
